message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_16457","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_frame_header_","line":2366,"var":"decoder->private_->input","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_utf8_uint64(decoder->private_->input, &xx, raw_header, &raw_header_len))","role":"source","note":"Frame-header parsing consumes attacker-controlled bytes from the input stream into the bitreader."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_utf8_uint64","line":1070,"var":"x","code":"if(!(x & 0x80) || (x & 0x40)) { /* 10xxxxxx */","role":"root_cause","note":"The UTF-8 continuation-byte check is wrong: it accepts bytes with bit 6 set, so malformed multi-byte sequences can be treated as valid and advance parsing state incorrectly."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_frame_header_","line":2369,"var":"raw_header[raw_header_len-1]","code":"decoder->private_->lookahead = raw_header[raw_header_len-1];","role":"intermediate","note":"On malformed UTF-8, the decoder rewinds using the last byte seen, preserving the misparsed header state for subsequent sync/search logic."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_frame_header_","line":2430,"var":"raw_header","code":"if(FLAC__crc8(raw_header, raw_header_len) != crc8)","role":"sink","note":"The decoder computes CRC over the over-extended raw_header buffer after the malformed UTF-8 path has appended extra bytes, which is the target invalid read path in the vulnerable frame-header handling."}],` executed with exit code -1.
